title: crm.sale.sale-completed, payload v1
description: The SALE's terminal fact (ADR-018 §7). Destination: crm.sale.evt.sale-completed.v1. Produced by order-service in the SAME transaction that moves the saga to COMPLETED, and ONLY from that transition — so a consumer can never observe it for a sale that is not complete. This is the CHOREOGRAPHY seam (ADR-017 §2): by the time it exists the products are ACTV and linked to the account, so a reaction that fails cannot fail the sale. The test for whether a new requirement belongs here or in the saga is 'if this step fails, must the sale be undone?' — no means here.

orderNumber.description: The KR-12 number, which is also the sagaId and the envelope aggregateId.

customerNumber.description: As reported by account-service during the saga, never client-supplied.

productIds.description: The products this sale created, now ACTV and linked to the account.

totalAmount.description: The order's stored amount snapshot. Non-normative demo fixtures feed it (ADR-018 §2).
